Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5104090. Left join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls for missing structures. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID. Do not deduplicate rows.
